evals.name: claims-ledger-first
evals.prompt: Write the App Store and Play listing for this app in Italian and English.
evals.expected_output: Reads the product before writing, builds a claims ledger with evidence per claim, records banned terms, writes native Italian and English copy, and delivers lint-clean text in the canonical listing format.

evals.name: no-invented-aso-data
evals.prompt: Pick the best keywords and tell me how many more downloads we will get.
evals.expected_output: Marks volume as unknown without supplied data, ranks candidates by relevance and specificity, asks for Search Ads/Analytics/Play search terms, and refuses to predict uplift.

evals.name: apple-keyword-hygiene
evals.prompt: Audit our App Store keywords: name 'Brand: stanze in affitto', subtitle 'Trova stanza e coinquilini', keywords 'stanza,affitto,coinquilini,camera,posto letto'.
evals.expected_output: Flags words repeated from name and subtitle (including plural/singular), spaces after commas, proposes replacement terms from the claims ledger, and keeps the field within 100 characters and bytes.

evals.name: play-metadata-rules
evals.prompt: Check our Play listing: title 'MatchRoom - FREE Rooms #1!', short description 'Download now and find the best room!'.
evals.expected_output: Flags free/ranking claims and caps in the title, the call to action and superlative in the short description, citing the Play Metadata policy, and proposes compliant rewrites within 30 and 80 characters.

evals.name: release-notes-from-changelog
evals.prompt: Turn our CHANGELOG into release notes for both stores.
evals.expected_output: Checks changelog freshness against the app version and falls back to git when stale, filters internal commits, writes user-language bullets per locale, respects Apple 4000 and Play 500 characters per language with language tags, and omits promotion.

evals.name: placeholder-notes-flagged
evals.prompt: fastlane/release_notes.txt says 'MatchRoom beta build'. Ready to upload?
evals.expected_output: Flags the placeholder as unsuitable for store notes (Apple 2.3.12/2.1(a)) and asks for or drafts real user-facing notes.

evals.name: listing-vs-privacy-policy
evals.prompt: Our description says ranking compares budget, dates and habits. The privacy policy says ranking also uses age, gender and occupation.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the contradiction as a listing accuracy and transparency issue, proposes a non-enumerating statement that points to the Terms, and does not leave the incomplete list.

evals.name: banned-terms-in-negation
evals.prompt: Our rule: the words 'dating' and 'incontri' must never appear in the listing. The description says 'not a dating app'.
evals.expected_output: Treats the negated mention as a violation of the project rule (warning level in lint), proposes a positive rewrite, and keeps the explicit statement in the review notes instead.

evals.name: existing-asset-pack-verified
evals.prompt: The screenshots are ready in output/app-store, the README says all sizes are correct.
evals.expected_output: Verifies dimensions, alpha and video specs with sips/ffprobe instead of trusting the README, notes missing locales and Play assets, and checks that captions match the plan.

evals.name: read-only
evals.prompt: Write the listing and upload it to App Store Connect.
evals.expected_output: Delivers files and paste-ready text, does not upload or edit any console, and explains how to apply the text (fastlane deliver/supply or console).
